Education reference study

One ZIP was supplied: premium-education-ui-screens.zip. It contains 18 distinct reference images, duplicate copies for its preview, a README and an interactive HTML preview. The screenshots were inspected as design inspiration rather than reused as site artwork.

Design synthesis

A school prospectus needs to help families understand the school, compare educational stages and take an informed next step. The site combines editorial headings, natural student photography, navy structural elements, sky-blue learning sections and amber calls to action. Content stacks on mobile, touch controls remain large, and motion respects reduced-motion settings.

Skills installed for Claude Code

Taste, Emil design engineering, Impeccable, Jakub’s interface skills and Shadcn skills are installed in this project. The standard Apple Design skill is also present. The exact personal apple-design-hig fork was not supplied and has not been installed under that name.

Content status

Crestwood is a working brand. School programmes and policies are illustrative, and the three student photographs are generated. Admissions checklists and visit plans download locally; they do not submit applications or book visits. Replace the identity, contacts, policies and photography with verified school material before public launch.
